description.github: Automatically create and manage GitHub Issues for vulnerabilities detected in your projects. This integration helps your development team track and fix security issues directly in GitHub.
description.gitlab: Automatically create and manage GitLab Issues for vulnerabilities detected in your projects. This integration helps your development team track and fix security issues directly in GitLab.

description.github: Make sure your project is connected to a GitHub repository. You can do this in the integrations settings.
description.gitlab: Make sure your project is connected to a GitLab repository. You can do this in the integrations settings.

step2.title: Select a project
step2.description: Go to your projects page and select the project where you want to enable issue tracking.

step3.title: Enable issue creation
step3.description: In the project settings, go to the 'Issues' tab and enable automatic issue creation. You can also choose how issues should be grouped.

issueIntegrationModal.infoDescription: Once enabled, issues will be automatically created after each scan. Issues are also automatically closed when vulnerabilities are resolved.
